description: A company commander must publish Friday's medical-readiness screening schedule for three platoons, assign each platoon to an available clinic block, and record the coordination controls needed for the screenings.

shared_context.S1: The company must complete medical-readiness screenings for Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie Platoons on Friday.
shared_context.S2: The supporting clinic has reserved three screening blocks: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1300-1500, with one platoon scheduled per block.
shared_context.S3: Capt. Morgan publishes the company schedule and coordinates transportation and clinic support.
shared_context.S4: During the routine readiness synchronization before the schedule is signed, the medical, motor pool, and personnel-readiness staff report any updates affecting their assigned support.

PF1.text: The clinic pharmacist is available for Bravo Platoon's screening only during the 1000-1200 block because six Bravo personnel require an immunization review; Lt. Alvarez confirmed the pharmacist's roster this morning, but the clinic staffing update has not yet been added to the company schedule.

PF2.text: The assigned transport van cannot be released for Charlie Platoon until 1230 after a brake inspection, so Charlie must use the 1300-1500 clinic block; SFC Brooks received the inspection release time from the motor pool supervisor this morning, but it has not been posted to the movement board.

PF3.text: Alpha Platoon's screening roster includes personnel who must fast beforehand, requiring Alpha to use the first 0800-1000 block; Sgt. Patel verified the roster against the clinic instructions yesterday, but the fasting requirement has not been included in the draft schedule.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha Platoon must be assigned to 0800-1000 because its roster requires fasting before screening.
Bravo Platoon must be assigned to 1000-1200 because its personnel require the pharmacist's immunization review.
Charlie Platoon must be assigned to 1300-1500 because its transport van is unavailable until 1230.
The schedule must include a transport-release control for Charlie at 1230.
The medical staffing fact must be cited by the commander.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'transport_release' and c['target'] == 'Charlie Platoon' and c['detail'] == 'Release vehicle at 1230' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The pharmacist's availability changes Bravo Platoon's assignment from an otherwise open block to exactly 1000-1200 and provides the medical staffing fact that must be cited.
The van's 1230 release time changes Charlie Platoon's block to exactly 1300-1500 and changes the schedule by requiring a 1230 transport-release control.
The fasting requirement changes Alpha Platoon's assignment to the exact first block, 0800-1000, rather than either later clinic block.
